listing.name: In Cold Blood / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port prepared with your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Complete setup with the project’s launcher; you manage this copy, its updates and your saved data.

steps.title: Download and unpack the setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder. On Linux use your native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3. On Intel or Apple Silicon Mac, choose the matching archive and put the Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH.

steps.title: Supply the matching originals in order
steps.instruction: Use your own USA two-disc set SLUS-01294 then SLUS-01314. Keep each disc image and every referenced track together. Use the kit’s supported BIOS instructions. Follow the bundled setup guide for the image formats and BIOS selection.

steps.title: Build and add the completed player
steps.instruction: Run the In_Cold_Blood_Recompiled setup host (with .exe on Windows), then use its Generate & rebuild wizard. Add the completed player from build-release with that folder as its start folder. Keep the whole creating folder and its runtime companions.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.
The guide covers upstream-owned setup and replacement. Preserve all discs, saves, settings and overlay captures. Disc changes during gameplay remain unobserved.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. Use the project’s tools for updates and back up your original files, saves and settings yourself.
